Summary: Checks whether the cutover or deployment path was rehearsed enough to trust the event plan.
EntryCriteria: A significant release or cutover event is nearing execution.
ExitCriteria: Rehearsal or dry-run evidence is sufficient for the declared risk level.
Checks: Cutover sequence has been walked through or rehearsed.
Hold points and rollback triggers are understood.
Support and communication escalation paths are tested.
